shots.visual_description: Close-up of dull, slightly textured skin on a cheek, dramatic overhead lighting, macro lens, showing uneven tone.
shots.narration: 每天照镜子，是不是总觉得皮肤暗沉、没有光泽？

shots.visual_description: Product hero shot of the whitening mask, soft glow, rotating slowly on a pristine white marble surface with subtle steam effect.
shots.narration: 别担心！这款美白面膜，专为提亮肤色而生，给你惊喜。
shots.text_overlay: 美白面膜 焕亮登场

shots.visual_description: Female hands gently applying a generous layer of the mask onto one half of a clean face, natural soft light, close-up on the mask texture as it spreads evenly.
shots.narration: 轻柔涂抹，感受丝滑质地，让肌肤尽情吸收美白精华。
shots.text_overlay: 左脸挑战 见证奇迹

shots.visual_description: Time-lapse of the mask drying slightly, then hands carefully peeling off the mask cleanly from the face, revealing fresh skin underneath.
shots.narration: 15分钟，奇迹发生！揭下面膜，肌肤焕然一新。
shots.text_overlay: 净透焕亮 轻松拥有

shots.visual_description: Split-screen showing the 'before' side (dull, uneven) and 'after' side (bright, even, radiant) of the same face, bright even studio lighting, genuine happy expression.
shots.narration: 看看这对比！左脸明显提亮，肤色均匀，仿佛自带柔光。
shots.text_overlay: 左右脸对比 效果看得见

shots.visual_description: Product array (3-5 masks) with a clear price tag overlay and a '限时优惠' (Limited Time Offer) banner, warm inviting lighting, subtle sparkling effect.
shots.narration: 还在等什么？立即入手，让你的肌肤也告别暗沉，闪耀光采！
shots.text_overlay: 限时优惠 立即抢购
